summary: Frontend-only test of the FocusEdge Journey card / avatar-stage bug fix (desktop 1920x1080). Checked against GET /api/reports/<id> for fe-aarav, fe-meher and fe-vihaan. All 6 requested features passed. Header and summary are calculated from the student's data. Stage = 1 + floor(ticks/5). The avatar grows only when the 'Yes' total crosses a multiple of 5, and never on logging alone. Future days are locked and show no avatar. Calm Streak matches the stage. Check-in saves (PATCH 200), shows a toast and closes the dialog.

verified_details.fe-aarav_before: Summary '8 of 14 days logged · 24 activities done · Stage 5 of 14'; next-stage text '1 more activity to reach Stage 6'; Day 9 of 14. Day-by-day stages 1,1,2,3,3,4,5,5. 'New stage' chip shown only on Days 3, 4, 6 and 7, which matches cumulative ticks 2,4,7,10,12,16,20,24. Activity chips (data-done) match the ticks for each day. Day 10 onward: data-locked=true, 0 images, 'Unlocks tomorrow' / 'Locked'. Day 10 main card says 'Locked · Not unlocked yet · unlocks on Nov 13'.
verified_details.fe-aarav_all_No: Daily-log-next-stage stayed at 'Stage 5 · 1 more "Yes" answer…' through all 5 'No' answers. PATCH 200, 'Saved to your plan' toast, dialog closed. Summary became '9 of 14 days logged · 24 activities done · Stage 5 of 14'. streak-earned 5/14, day streak 9, no 'New stage' chip. Description: 'checked in but no plan activities… avatar stayed where it was'. Same values after reload.
verified_details.fe-meher_Yes: Before: 5 logged, 5 activities, Stage 2, '5 more…'. Stages by day were correct (grew on Day 5). The live line counted down 5→4→(No) 5→(Yes) 4→3→2→1, then 'Stage 3 · 5 more…' after the 5th Yes, and the dialog avatar src changed stage2→stage3 at that point. After submit: '6 of 14 days logged · 10 activities done · Stage 3 of 14', streak-earned 3/14, 3 badges earned, today's card shows a 'New stage' chip with stage3.webp, previous day shows stage2.webp.
verified_details.fe-vihaan: Title 'Your 14-Day Focus Journey — complete', badge 'Journey complete', '14 of 14 days logged · 58 activities done · Stage 12 of 14', '2 more activities to reach Stage 13', 12/14 badges. Per-day stages all correct.
verified_details.calm_streak_footer: 'Every 5 plan activities you complete unlock your next growth stage — you only ever move forward.' is present.

design_issues.screen: Journey main card mood buttons (journey-mood-3 'Steady' selected)
issues: The selected 'Steady' pill uses a light lavender background with white text, so contrast is low (seen on fe-aarav after check-in). 'Strong' (darker) reads fine.
The toast reads 'New stage unlocked: Balanced — … 6-day streak!'. It mixes streak wording into stage growth, which now depends on activities. Consider dropping the streak mention to avoid confusion.

action_items: Optional: raise the contrast of the selected light mood pill (Steady) on the journey card.
Optional: remove the 'N-day streak' wording from the stage-unlock toast, since stages now depend on activities.
critical_code_review_comments: stages.js: doneUpTo parses the day from the tick string. Ticks with a malformed format would give NaN and be silently excluded. Acceptable.

Not covered by the seeded data: a past day that was not logged ('Not logged', same stage as the day before). I could not exercise it in the UI. The code path (dayInfo returns label 'Not logged', stageAt carries the previous stage when there are no ticks) looks correct.
JourneyCard keeps sel state from the first render. After saving a check-in while browsing another day, the card stays on that day instead of jumping to today. This is minor and expected.
seed_data_creation: None created. The test used up today's (Nov 12) check-ins for fe-aarav (Day 9, all No → 9 logged, 24 ticks, Stage 5) and fe-meher (Day 6, all 5 Yes + mood Strong → 6 logged, 10 ticks, Stage 3), as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server date is Nov 2026. fe-aarav and fe-meher now have today's check-in done. To re-test the dialog you need a new day or a reseed by the main agent. fe-vihaan has 2 FocusEdge reports (same data, duplicate seed record at 16:54). Navigate days with journey-prev-btn/journey-next-btn: the strip shows only 5 days, so journey-day-<d> exists only for visible days.
